required_arb_sections.content_boundary: Interpret only retained granular field-accuracy results, companion counts, section breakdowns, and per-field comparisons against the same captured Golden result from the accepted generation. Preserve schema and ordering diagnostics separately from content accuracy.
Report each registered prerequisite as satisfied or unsatisfied with concrete reasons, and identify the runner evidence class.
Interpret only registered retained dependency/effective-execution evidence and preserve unavailable, invalid, or non-comparable states.
State evidence limitations and bound conclusions to the accepted cases, treatments, comparison track, and invariant execution boundary.

metric_display.granular_counts: Show correct_units / (expected_units + unexpected_units) for each scored observation; aggregation numerator and denominator describe means of scores, not pooled fields.

conclusion_boundaries: Exact-stdout behavior is a primary conclusion only when an active registration explicitly selects it as the primary endpoint; otherwise it remains secondary or diagnostic according to registration.

A field-content score of 1 does not certify ordering, schema validity, or full contract equivalence; report their retained diagnostics. Equal field weights are the registered initial metric policy, not an empirical importance weighting.

limitations: This selectable report configuration has no authority until an accepted ARB benchmark registration explicitly binds it.
